title: Conformal Novelty Detection via Data-enhanced Localization
abstract: arXiv:2610.34999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Novelty detection is an important area of research in both statistics and machine learning. In this paper, we focus on the conditional novelty detection problem, where novelties arise from the relationship between different variables. We first adopt the conformal inference framework and propose a data-enhanced localized conformal p-value, constructed by recalibrating an enhanced conditional distribution estimator. This estimator efficiently captures conditional information by incorporating both calibration and test data into its kernel estimation. We show that our p-values are valid in finite samples and can improve detection efficiency. Based on this p-value, we then develop a novel conditional novelty detection algorithm, along with a data-driven bandwidth selection method that ensures finite-sample false discovery rate control while enhancing detection power. translated_title: 基于数据增强局部化的保形新颖性检测
translated_abstract: 新颖性检测是统计学和机器学习领域的一个重要研究方向。本文关注条件新颖性检测问题，即新颖性产生于不同变量之间的关系。我们首先采用保形推断框架，提出了一种数据增强的局部化保形p值，该p值通过重新校准增强的条件分布估计器而构建。该估计器通过将校准数据和测试数据同时纳入核估计，高效地捕捉条件信息。我们证明了所提出的p值在有限样本下是有效的，并且能够提高检测效率。基于该p值，我们进一步开发了一种新颖的条件新颖性检测算法，并配套一种数据驱动的带宽选择方法，该方法在增强检测功效的同时确保有限样本下的错误发现率控制。模拟数据和真实数据实验均展示了我们方法的优越性。
tldr: 本文提出一种数据增强的局部化保形p值及相应的条件新颖性检测算法，利用数据驱动带宽选择在有限样本下保证错误发现率控制的同时提升了检测功效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-enhanced localized conformal p-value and a novel conditional novelty detection algorithm with data-driven bandwidth selection, which ensures finite-sample false discovery rate control while improving detection power.
